name: mobile-catalog-place
description: Mobile: catalog opens as sheet, minimize toggles, tap a card closes catalog + arms ghost with Place item? pill.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: expand-and-tap
steps.eval: (()=>{const st=window.__store.getState(); const exp=[...document.querySelectorAll('.catalog .panel-head .icon-btn')].find(x=>/Expand/i.test(x.getAttribute('aria-label')||'')); exp&&exp.click(); setTimeout(()=>{ const card=document.querySelector('.cat-card'); if(card) card.click(); }, 300);})()

steps.name: check-place
steps.eval: (()=>{const st=window.__store.getState(); console.log('PLACE_STATE '+JSON.stringify({activeDefId: st.activeDefId, placeConfirm: st.placeConfirm, catalogOpen: st.catalogOpen, pill: !!document.querySelector('.edit-confirm')}))})()
